name: Input Align External
description: Experimental input correction with a separate local simulator.

enabled.name: Enabled
enabled.description: Turns the input buffer on or off.

invisible-trajectory.name: Invisible trajectory
invisible-trajectory.description: Correccion predictiva sin dibujar trayectorias. Desactivado: los clics pasan directamente.

cbf-sync.name: CBF sync (reservado)
cbf-sync.description: Ajuste reservado por compatibilidad con InputAlign. La sincronizacion sub-tick aun no esta implementada: con CBF detectado o pasos parciales se conserva siempre la entrada original, incluso con este ajuste desactivado.

language.name: Menu language
language.description: Language of the Buffer menu. You can also switch it with the language button at the top of the menu.

normal-ticks.name: Normal ticks
normal-ticks.description: Max delay (in ticks) for cube, ball, UFO, spider, robot and swing. 4 ticks = 1 frame at 60 fps.

wave-ticks.name: Wave ticks
wave-ticks.description: Max delay (in ticks) while in wave. 4 ticks = 1 frame at 60 fps.

spam-guard.name: Spam guard
spam-guard.description: Tras tres pulsaciones separadas por menos del intervalo, deja pasar directamente las entradas mientras continue la rafaga.

spam-interval.name: Spam interval (ticks)
spam-interval.description: Clicks closer together than this count as spam. 20 ticks = 12 clicks/sec.

buffer-normal.name: Buffer in cube and others
buffer-normal.description: Use the buffer in cube, ball, UFO, spider, robot and swing.

buffer-wave.name: Buffer in wave
buffer-wave.description: Use the buffer while in wave.

buffer-practice-only.name: Buffer only in practice mode
buffer-practice-only.description: The buffer only acts in Practice Mode; normal runs are left untouched.

macro-record.name: Record and analyze my runs
macro-record.description: Guarda en JSON los clics originales, aplicados y las correcciones al terminar el intento. No reproduce macros.

macro-file.name: Reference macro file
macro-file.description: Referencia .gdr.json / JSON con inputs, o TXT/CSV frame accion a 240 Hz. Compara acciones del jugador 1 dentro de 80 ticks y guarda referenceDelta. No reproduce macros. GDR binario no compatible.

macro-compare.name: Compare my clicks with the macro
macro-compare.description: While you play, each click is matched with the nearest macro input (same type, within 80 ticks) and the difference is recorded. Needs a macro file loaded and "Record and analyze my runs" on.

background-image.name: Menu background image
background-image.description: Pick a PNG or JPG to use as the background of the Buffer menu. Leave empty for the default look. Tip: use images up to about 1024x1024 so the game does not run out of memory.

background-opacity.name: Background opacity (%)
background-opacity.description: How visible the custom background is.

background-dim.name: Background darkening (%)
background-dim.description: Darkens the custom background so the buttons and text are easier to read.

noclip.name: Noclip (practice mode only)
noclip.description: You do not die from obstacles. Only works while playing in Practice Mode, so it never affects normal runs.

game-speed.name: Game speed (practice mode only)
game-speed.description: Speed of the game, from 0.10x (slow motion) to 2.00x. Only applies in Practice Mode.

auto-close.name: Menu auto-close (seconds)
auto-close.description: Segundos sin tocar esta ventana antes de cerrarse. 0: nunca.

menu-color.name: Menu color
menu-color.description: Color del fondo del menu. Ajustable en la pantalla de configuracion de Geode.

menu-opacity.name: Menu opacity (%)
menu-opacity.description: How opaque the floating Buffer menu is.

menu-scale.name: Menu size (%)
menu-scale.description: Size of the floating Buffer menu.

menu-lock.name: Lock menu position
menu-lock.description: Bloquea el arrastre de la ventana desde su titulo.

hud-fps.name: HUD: FPS counter
hud-fps.description: Shows the real FPS inside the level.

hud-cps.name: HUD: CPS counter
hud-cps.description: Shows your clicks per second inside the level.

hud-clicks.name: HUD: click counter
hud-clicks.description: Shows the click count of the current attempt.

hud-saved.name: HUD: buffer saves
hud-saved.description: Correcciones retrasadas aplicadas con estado coincidente; no equivale a muertes evitadas verificadas.

hud-noclip-deaths.name: HUD: noclip hits
hud-noclip-deaths.description: Colisiones mortales suprimidas por noclip en practica; un contacto prolongado puede contar varias veces.

hud-corner.name: HUD corner
hud-corner.description: Screen corner for the in-level counters.

no-wave-trail.name: Hide wave trail
no-wave-trail.description: Hides the wave trail. Visual only, it does not change physics.

performance-mode.name: Performance mode
performance-mode.description: Lighter mode for low-end devices: the buffer uses half of its simulation budget per tick and the wave trail is hidden. On very heavy levels the buffer may correct a bit less.

max-correction-ms.name: Max correction time (ms)
max-correction-ms.description: Presupuesto por consulta del proceso externo; no bloquea el hilo del juego. Un presupuesto mayor consume mas CPU.

button-corner.name: Pause button corner
button-corner.description: Where the Buffer button appears in the pause menu.

button-scale.name: Pause button size
button-scale.description: Size of the Buffer button in the pause menu.

button-opacity.name: Button opacity (%)
button-opacity.description: Opacidad del boton IAX del menu de pausa. Con 0 el area sigue activa; restaura la visibilidad desde Geode > Input Align External > Settings.

all-ticks-400.name: Todo a 400 ticks
all-ticks-400.description: Usa 400 para Normal y Wave sin cambiar el presupuesto de CPU. Al desactivar recupera los valores individuales. Shift+Tab activa/desactiva la correccion dentro del nivel.
